body:
Partially addresses #39 — the file-management half: agents can now find and organize Docs without leaving gdoc. Bulk comment actions, `--include-deleted`, and the comment location map are deliberately left as follow-up (they're the separately-scoped review-workflow half of the issue).

## New commands

```bash
gdoc mkdir 'Project docs' --parent FOLDER
gdoc mv DOC FOLDER            # alias: move
gdoc rename DOC 'New title'
gdoc drives
gdoc find --raw "mimeType='application/vnd.google-apps.document' and 'me' in owners"
gdoc share DOC --domain example.org --role reader --discoverable
gdoc share DOC --anyone
```

## Design notes (per the issue's safety section)

- **`mv` replaces all parents** — Drive files can have multiple legacy parents; a move ends with the file in exactly one place, and the final `parents` list is reported in every output mode.
- **`mv`/`rename` participate in the awareness system** — pre-flight runs first, and the operation's own version bump is passed as `command_version` so the next command doesn't report our own write as an external edit.
- **Raw queries are explicit opt-in** — plain `find QUERY` keeps its escaped name/content search; `--raw` passes the string verbatim to the Drive query language. `--raw --title` is rejected (put name conditions in the query).
- **Discoverability is never inferred** — `allowFileDiscovery` is off unless `--discoverable` is passed, and that flag errors on per-user shares. Exactly one share target (EMAIL, `--domain`, `--anyone`) is required; notification email is only sent for user shares (the API rejects it for link-based grants).
- **Output stability** — user-share JSON/plain keys are unchanged (`email`/`role`/`status`); domain/anyone shares add `target`/`type`/`discoverable`.
- Shared-drive support: all new Drive calls pass `supportsAllDrives=True`, and `drives` paginates.

## Verification

- 30 new tests + 4 updated share tests (1267 total on this branch, all passing); ruff clean on touched code.
- Live smoke test: created a folder, created a doc, moved it in (`OK moved to <folder>`), renamed it (verified via `info`), found both via `find --raw`, `drives` handled the no-shared-drives case, `share --anyone` succeeded. Scratch doc + folder deleted.

Note: independent branch off main; version bumped to 0.16.0 (0.15.0 is PR #41). Whichever merges second will need a trivial CHANGELOG/version-ordering rebase — I'll handle it at merge time.
